pages: O-of course it is!
Anyone whose heart is not stirred by such a fiery duel...
is no man at all!
...You seem to have a very straightforward nature.
Take my advice. Pack your things and go home right now.
Wh-what!? You mean you cannot take me as a pupil!?
That's right.
Hurry home, apologize to your lord and tell him you learned a great deal...
That is what you should report...
Oh... so I...
I lack the talent to meet your standards, Master Nicotine...
Don't misunderstand me!
That's not what I mean...
With enough effort, you could become a master swordsman.
You could likely even earn full mastery of your school.
You would not lose to an ordinary swordsman,
and you could serve your lord well with your spear.
And yet... I cannot... become your pupil...
I understand...
I, Abiko, can become a master, but never a true expert!
If I am unworthy of walking the path of the sword to its end...
then it is the same as falling halfway down that path!
I shall cut open my belly here and at least atone to my lord!
Y-you fool!
You still need to learn a bit more about discipline.
Cutting your belly just because things don't go your way...
That's no better than fleeing before the enemy! ...Hm?
Isn't that the very thing a samurai should be ashamed of?
F-fleeing... before the enemy...
That's right.
And you don't understand the feelings of your lord at all...
the one who gladly sent you off to train...
My lord's...
Hmm...
I suspect your lord sent you off gladly not to train in the sword,
but to train in life itself.
Come back a bigger man, he must have thought.
No... he may even think that if you found a better purpose in life,
that alone would be enough...
Master Nicotine...
To fail to repay such a great lord,
and waste your life by cutting your belly... THAT is a samurai's shame...
Wouldn't you agree?
...I have nothing to say.
So you understand?
I, Abiko, was shallow.
But still, still I must beg you to take me on as your pupil!
Hmm... I suppose it can't be helped.
Then I shall look after you for about a week.
Oh...! Then you mean...!
Don't jump to conclusions...
I haven't said I'll take you as a pupil yet!
Good grief...
Whew...
Not a wasted motion in those swings... You've trained well, I see.
Master Nicotine... is it not time...
Please, give me even a single word of guidance...
Fwahahaha...
For now, I have nothing to say to you...
From today I will do 1000 swings!
Ah, stop, stop that!
Didn't I tell you at the start?
Just do your usual practice, the way you always do...
Yes, but...
Yes, but this is no different from before!
I don't ask for secret arts right away, but the training you gave Haohmaru and Genjuro...
I wish to undergo Kafuin style training too...
...I never taught those two anything.
B-but...
For one thing, there's no such thing as a Kafuin style.
Genjuro calls his style Koin Itto-ryu,
and Haohmaru says his is self-taught.
I didn't teach them their secret arts either...
They worked those out themselves through great hardship.
Why, I can't even do a Senpu Retsuzan or a Goko Zan.
Disappointed?
Then... then, Master Nicotine...
what on earth did you pass on to those two?
The essence of the sword? Or the tactics of a duel?
The secrets of strategy?
Master Nicotine!
Please, I beg you, teach that to me!
I know full well how unskilled I am!
But still... still...
...I'm sorry,
but that's not something that can be taught with words...
Genjuro never did understand it,
and I wonder if even Haohmaru truly understands...
Wh-what!? Not even those two!?
...Abiko.
Y-yes, sir!
I knew it... you are...
not a man who belongs in a place like this...
...I was prepared for it, but actually hearing those words...
it hurts as if I were cut... it hurts so...
So much that it would be easier to take my own life...
Abiko!
No, Master Nicotine...
I, Abiko, have grown a little.
I will no longer give up over something like this...
Hm... well said!
But, before I say farewell,
I ask you to strike down my immaturity just once more...
That is my final request.
...Abiko... as I said at the start,
you have more talent for the sword than most men.
But you are not a man who can only live by the sword.
Hmm...
I do not quite grasp your meaning.
Haohmaru and Genjuro are clumsy men.
...They're idiots.
Flawed men who can only express themselves by swinging a sword.
You are not like that.
You're young, so you're still a bit reckless,
but you are earnest and good-natured.
I'm sure everyone will be fond of you...
Go home, apologize to your lord and serve him once more.
Return to your old dojo, train hard and aim for full mastery.
You can do that. That is the path you should fulfill.
...In other words, I have no talent...
No, I understand. I shall take my leave.
W-wait... That's not it...
Oh my, are you leaving already?
Why not have some breakfast before you go?
...The path of the sword is a path of carnage.
To be invincible is to pile up corpses, spill rivers of blood...
and survive...
It is never what you imagine it to be...
some clash of strength between men...
Not at all...
Listen, Abiko... please understand...
It's not that you lack talent and so I can't take you.
It's that I am not worthy to be the master of a man like you.
Mister Nicotine, should I make breakfast for just one this morning?
Oh... oh my, yes! Sorry to always trouble you...
Damn it...
Whoa! How strange! Wh-who are you!?
I am but a humble Kuroko.
I know what you're thinking!
Nicotine doesn't like me,
so he said something plausible to get rid of me nicely... right?
H-how rude! Who are you!?
I am but a humble Kuroko.
But Sir Abiko, you are mistaken...
Wha-what? This grows stranger and stranger...
How do you know my name...?
I am Kuroko. There is nothing I do not know.
Sir Abiko, please try to grasp Master Nicotine's true intent.
Hmm...! His true intent!?
Not just Haohmaru and Genjuro...
Master Nicotine, too, can only live by the sword...
His lament was also a lament for himself.
Master Nicotine did not take Haohmaru and the others as pupils
because he saw their talent for the sword,
nor did he mean to raise great swordsmen.
Wh-what!?
You... you too, like Master Nicotine,
mean to talk me around with clever words, don't you?
I have no such intention.
I am only meddling because your talent would be wasted.
Whether you listen or not is up to you.
If you don't, it simply means your caliber goes no further than that,
and I will give up on you.
Hmph...! You dare say that!
...Very well. Go on with your speech!
If your excuses sound suspicious, I'll cut you down!
As you wish...
Now, are you aware that long ago, Master Nicotine
was a famous swordsman?
With his skill and his powers as a sorcerer,
he slew the demons that brought harm to this world.
But one day,
he was utterly powerless against a mighty demon,
and was thoroughly beaten...
Since then, he has trained at Kokain, deep in the Hida mountains,
praying for the souls of all whose blood he has spilled.
Human blood, demon blood...
Humans and demons alike... you say...
Yes...
This is nothing more than my own guess, but...
perhaps the reason Master Nicotine took those two as pupils...
was an extension of those prayers for the dead,
or perhaps he saw his former self in the two of them,
or perhaps he wished to be there to support them.
The path of the sword Master Nicotine has walked
is not the path of the sword you walked in your dojo.
What you were hoping for from Master Nicotine...
was likely something he could never have given you.
That's right.
In other words, you were troubling Master Nicotine,
it would seem.
What a blunder!
Isn't it obvious!?
I must return to Kokain and apologize for the trouble!
No, no... there's no need for that.
I will pass your feelings on to Master Nicotine myself.
Well then... but...
It would be better to meet him again
after you've grown a bit more.
...There's no need to rush.
No... I understand. I'm grateful.
I am truly disgusted with myself.
Unskilled, understanding nothing, yet always so impatient...
Now, now, just think of this as part of your training.
Someday you will surely bloom into a great flower.
...I'm sure of it.
I believe I told you...
I am but a humble Kuroko...
After that, Abiko Motojiro Masaharu
returned to his lord in Shimousa, Matsudo Shigenao,
and served him with all his heart.
He also trained hard in the Kakushin Muso style, earned full mastery,
and inherited the dojo.
Cheerful and earnest, Masaharu was trusted by his lord and loved by all.
He lived long and served three generations of the Matsudo,
and was said to be a fine retainer, a pillar of the Matsudo clan.
Ladies and gentlemen!
A special program just for you who cleared Bushido Retsuden!
Our special program!
It's called 'Here at the Item Shop'!!
Broadcast live, literally, from the South Edo Item Shop!
I, Kuroko, will be your host!
Today we have a wonderful guest with us.
An old acquaintance of mine and a comrade who fought Mizuki with me...
Master Kafuin Nicotine!
Now, in this episode of 'Here at the Item Shop',
our guest Master Nicotine will answer the questions
you sent us about Bushido Retsuden!
What strange and wacky questions will pop up!?
Let's get going!
Ahem, now then, our first letter...
From 'Go Tigers Go' of Nishinari, Osaka City.
...Ever since the miasma of hell messed up my head,
I got knocked out by Princess Ushiwaka in one hit.
Those swords on her geta are just too dangerous!
Please tell me anything at all about Princess Ushiwaka!
Also, is there a Princess Ushiwaka fan club?
Oh, a passionate question right off the bat...
Well, Master Nicotine, what do you think?
Hmm, I'm rather interested in that woman myself...
I've been reading the shogunate spy records, courtesy of Jubei,
so I'll tell you what I can...
When the Dark Lord revived Amakusa, as a servant,
he also revived another who died with a grudge against this world:
Lord Minamoto no Yoshitsune.
But few men had a body able to endure Yoshitsune's fierce soul.
There just weren't any...
So he used the body of a woman who adored the revived Amakusa
and gave him everything, as a vessel to bring him back...
That is Princess Ushiwaka.
I see...
So her loyalty toward Amakusa belongs to the woman
who became the vessel?
Yes... the overflowing fighting spirit is Yoshitsune's,
and the love for Amakusa is probably the woman's.
That fervent loyalty made her pride run wild,
so she underestimated Haohmaru and the others and lost again and again.
By the way, the three Kai brothers
were warrior brothers who sold their souls to hell, like Mitsurugi Doko.
Into those brothers were infused the souls
of Yoshitsune's loyal guards, it seems...
Also, for the gentlemen out there,
her measurements were recorded as 82-54-84.
Th-the shogunate spies
investigate things like that too?
Yes... of course! Since Lord Ieyasu, the Tokugawa
have held detailed information as the key to ruling the land...
With Jubei's divine eye, seeing through a woman's measurements
is child's play... As expected of Japan's greatest swordsman!
Ho, ho, ho...
I-I see...
So that's how 250 years of peace in Edo were kept?
Yes... that's exactly it.
Now, about the fan club...
Sadly, there is no Ushiwaka fan club at the moment.
There is, however, her guard corps, the Jusshitai...
Unfortunately they were cut from the Saturn version,
but they're a group of fanatical youths
who'd happily throw their lives away for Ushiwaka.
If you're interested, sell your soul to Amakusa
and get yourself into the Jusshitai!
Though I hear you must be quite handsome to be admitted.
If you're not confident, then at least a fan club
you could start yourself. Hoho.
Speaking of fan clubs,
I hear you joined the fan club
of Edo Komachi, Master Nicotine...
Hohoho...
Little Komachi is so cute, and she sings so well...
I wanted to join Megumi Matsumoto's fan club too, but
they told me 'Megumi hasn't been born yet in this era,'
and turned me down...
Grumble, grumble...
Also, though he doesn't appear in this Bushido Retsuden,
Ukyo has a fan club too, you know...
Heh heh, actually I'm a member myself...
Um, speaking of Ukyo, we have a question about him...
...from 'Ukyo's Ribbon' of Chiyoda, Tokyo.
Here's the letter.
Ukyo is sick and has little time left, so why does he always
leave his chest exposed?
Hmm, actually I've been wondering about that too...
Master Nicotine, what do you think?
Genjuro is the same,
but SNK characters basically all show a lot of skin...
Anyway, for all his complaining, Ukyo
is tough enough to walk around the whole world...
Maybe if he doesn't keep his chest open, he'd get cured
of his illness? Hohoho.
Hmm, thank you for that very deep answer.
Now, our next letter... from Makuhari City,
a question from 'Rufuku South Edo Branch Servant'.
Ahh, I never noticed that a castle had been built under Edo Castle.
Not at all.
How did they carry out such a huge construction project?
...Hmm... that's a harsh question...
...Master Nicotine, what do you say?
We could just say Amakusa's great magic kept the people from noticing,
but that would end it there, so let's add a twist.
This too is something I heard from the shogunate spies,
but there's a rumor that the Inverted Edo Castle was built
...surprisingly cheaply for how it looked.
Wh-what!?
The Inverted Edo Castle, said to cost hundreds of billions of yen?
Believe it or not, it was built from... plywood!
In some places, they say
they even used cardboard...
And the Dark Lord's magic
held it up from below so it wouldn't fall apart.
Hmm... the Dark Lord's magic...
Truly bottomless...
They say Kyoshiro struck a pose and stomped right through the floor...
that's how flimsy it was...
The work itself was rushed and sloppy,
and treasure chests were left lying around everywhere
because they were careless with the materials...
According to Demon A (32), who worked on the site,
it paid 300 yen an hour, with no travel or meal allowance,
so who could blame them...
If the rumor is true, then when the Inverted Edo Castle plan failed,
the way Amakusa backed off so easily
makes sense, doesn't it?
Well, it's just a rumor...
The truth is lost in the dark now... Hoho.
Um, then our next postcard,
from 'Gen-chan LOVE Yasu' of Suita City.
...Gen-chan... ah, that means Genjuro.
Every time he levels up he drinks sake and smashes the cup,
but where does he get those cups?
Uhh... questions like this
should go to Takatsu or Umemoto in the publicity department...
I have no idea...
Well, at any rate, he surely keeps them hidden inside his kimono,
no doubt about that.
Come to think of it, when saving,
he'd say 'You... know any shop with a sale on dishes?'
so he seems to worry about the cost.
Hohoho... That Genjuro...
Whenever a level up was near,
he must have hurried to restock!
I wonder what he did when he was abroad...
Sorry, let's leave that as homework for another time.
Well then, let's keep going...
A question from 'Hot Spring Gal' of Beppu City.
Traveling is my hobby,
and this year I really want to go abroad...
But I'd have to sneak out behind the shogunate's back, so it's so hard!
How did all the foreign samurai
get to Japan?
Aha... it's easy to forget,
but in this era Japan is still closed off to the world...
What do you think, Master Nicotine?
Galford
stowed away from a port town near San Francisco.
As for Cham Cham,
you'll understand if you play the Jaten Korin chapter.
Charlotte and Sieger
entered at Dejima in Nagasaki with official shogunate permission,
on the condition that they would not preach or trade.
Charlotte came by ship via India,
and Sieger came overland through Siberia.
And I hear Wan-Fu swam across the Sea of Japan.
...So there you have it.
Wow, that's Wan-Fu for you, so bold!
Now then, a question about that very Wan-Fu...
...from Anonymous in Hokkaido.
The other day, my big sister, another girlfriend and I
went to have fun in Kyoto together.
It was my first time in Kyoto and I was so giddy and excited,
when suddenly...
a weird old man spoke to us on the Gojo Bridge!
He called us 'manly men'!
How rude can you get! Hmph!
...So she says.
Master Nicotine, can't Wan-Fu tell men and women apart?
Wan-Fu is a big-hearted man... he doesn't care about gender.
To Wan-Fu, the word 'man'
probably means a person of great stature.
Since ancient times, China too
has had plenty of pretty warrior girls and beautiful generals...
So even if Wan-Fu called a woman a 'man',
there's nothing strange about it.
I see. I feel like I've been dodged with fancy learning, but
that's Master Nicotine for you!
And now it's time for our 'One Photo!' corner!!
This photo was sent in
by 'Love Hunter from the Future' of Kyoto City.
Inventing is my hobby, but some heartless travelers
mocked my invention and made me furious.
So, for revenge,
I snapped some embarrassing photos of them.
Please, in front of samurai fans across the nation,
put them on display for all to see!
Gahahaha!
...So he says.
Oh ho... this is quite something...
Everyone's sleeping faces, eh?
Well then, let's take a look...
Dim the lights, please.
Eek! Where do you think you're touching!?
I-it wasn't me!
Here it is!
Aha, Haohmaru and Kyoshiro...
They both sleep so messily...
Kyoshiro,
you don't even take off your makeup to sleep? A true actor!
Now, next up is... whoa!
Ohhh...
Ukyo and Galford...
Hmm, splendid.
Ukyo aside,
Galford, what a pathetic sight...
Rumor has it
Galford has low blood pressure and isn't a morning person.
...He still has a long way to go to master ninjutsu...
Genjuro, huh...
Mmm, sleeping hugging his sword. So picaresque, isn't it...
That Genjuro... no wonder his sword smells...
Well now, next...
Oh, this is...
The Nako-Rimu sisters and Cham Cham...
Hmm... the futon's in the way...
Ultimate... curse-breaking... replay secret art...
REWIND!!
Ooooh!
As expected of the everyday-use Kafuin secret art!
Hohohoho...
Um, next up is...
Splash Fount!
Waah! Lights, lights!
That was quite an accident, but
we did get a glimpse of the samurai's
unexpected true faces...
Hohoho...
Scrapped features are as many as the stars,
as they say...
Now, back to our question corner once again.
...This time let's go with the Youka Doukoku chapter.
...A question from Mr. Sagawa of Ise City.
...I work as a courier, and one of my fellows wandered
into some baffling place called the Demon Road.
What on earth is the Demon Road?
In truth, just like the demon realm, about the Demon Road
nothing is known for certain.
...The story does give bits and pieces, but...
In any case,
it's surely a hyperspace formed between the demon realm and this world...
One theory says that when the Animus Bell sends
negative energy to Mizuki, the warping of space
opens the Demon Road and forms the Gate of Hades... apparently.
Another theory says that, to send demons to the surface,
it's a road opened by Mizuki's hatred...
Well, the Animus Bell creates the Demon Road,
and wherever an Animus Bell is, a Gate of Hades surely appears.
Put the other way, if you follow the Demon Road,
you're sure to reach an Animus Bell.
I see... then,
now that the samurai have defeated Mizuki...
Indeed. The Gate of Hades will close,
and the Demon Road will vanish into another dimension once more...
So we'll be saying goodbye to the Mu Labyrinth for a while.
...I wanted to hear the 'Moai Ondo' one more time, too.
Next, from someone living on Block 3 of the demon realm...
Demon B.
In Jaten Korin, the Palenque Stone was in Greenhell,
so why was it in the Sun Temple in Youka Doukoku?
That's the question.
I went and asked the Greenhell elder directly!
According to the elder, since Amakusa took the Palenque Stone so easily,
they moved it into the temple, where demons couldn't touch it,
together with the Tanjir Stone.
But in exchange, the Palenque Stone's glow
no longer reached Greenhell directly,
so everyone fell to Xibalba's magic
...or so he said.
Protect the Palenque Stone, and the villagers suffer.
Save the villagers, and the Palenque Stone gets taken.
...And if the Palenque Stone is taken,
they'll suffer in the end anyway,
so maybe everyone in Greenhell
was ready to share the Palenque Stone's fate...
Um, then this is our last question...
Starting with 'Secret Swordsman' of Fuji City,
many of you sent in this question...
...Who exactly was Mizuki?
That's the question...
Information on this is limited too,
but let me tell you what we know so far...
About 1000 years ago, a baby was abandoned on Oki.
...The poor baby was put on a boat and set adrift at sea,
but this was no ordinary baby...
When you say baby, you don't mean a Red Kuroko, do you?
The baby seems to have been born with strange powers.
...With those powers,
the baby understood its cursed fate: hunger, cold, approaching death.
It sensed all of that by instinct, and feared, despaired and hated.
Hatred breeds anger, and anger breeds a scream.
The scream of that dark soul resonated with the Dark Lord...
The baby offered up its own body as a sacrifice,
and sold its soul to the Dark Lord...
The Dark Lord let the baby drift ashore at Mount Osore,
and had good villagers raise the child...
The girl, named Mizuki,
gained the spiritual power of Mount Osore and the Dark Lord's magic,
and became a fearsome being...
When Mizuki turned 13,
she offered the village that raised her as a sacrifice to the Dark Lord,
and as Mizuki, priestess of hell, made a pact of immortality.
